doubts.claim_under_doubt: the override path fails closed on every OSError
doubts.disproof_attempt: Path.exists() on an unreadable marker re-raises EACCES outside try_release's try; run_failopen turns it into exit 0.
doubts.disposition: FIXED: override_marker.used() returns True on OSError; test_an_unreadable_marker_means_used_not_released.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: dropping the global continuation join is safe
doubts.disproof_attempt: A quoted heredoc body fed to a shell keeps backslash-newline raw; bash joins it: bash <<'EOF'\ngit \\\ncommit -m x\nEOF was missed.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Join continuations in kept run-body lines.
doubts.disposition: FIXED: run_carry joins them in the kept copy only (delimiter comparison stays raw); test_a_continuation_in_a_shell_fed_quoted_body_joins.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: a plain commit is measured on the shell directory's project, never a silent switch
doubts.disproof_attempt: (a) a found project with no compliance data fell back to the default with no WARN; (b) project_root step-3 descent picked a project BELOW the shell directory, which the commit does not land in.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: WARN in (a); reject a resolved project that does not contain the shell directory in (b).
doubts.disposition: FIXED: both branches warn and use the managed default; two tests in test_hook_shell_cwd_scope.py.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: every command shape that runs git commit is seen
doubts.disproof_attempt: ANSI-C quoting $'..\'..' and '<<' inside ${...} are not modelled by the three scanners.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Model $'..' and ${...} or document the limit.
doubts.disposition: ACCEPTED and documented as a known limit in the ADR (adversarial; plausible accidental shapes have an odd quote count and reach the loose fallback).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: the segment parser recognises git commit behind common prefixes
doubts.disproof_attempt: Leading redirections, --config-env/--attr-source, wrappers outside the closed set (uv run, stdbuf, flock, setsid), env '#x=1', pwsh -CommandWithArgs.
doubts.disposition: DEFERRED: triage follow-up card, not part of this iterate.

summary: 1 high, 2 medium fixed with tests; 2 low accepted/deferred and documented. Could not break: double release of one entry, revival by git restore or sweep, any OSError inside the lock.
